The package declares appropriate dependencies, optional dependencies for various audio formats, and conflicts/provides for proper package management. All operations are limited to the build directory and the package directory, with no evidence of unauthorized network access, code execution, or file system modifications outside the build context.

There are no obfuscated commands, suspicious downloads, or attempts to exfiltrate data. The code aligns with standard AUR packaging practices for a Git-based package and does not introduce any malicious behavior.
